1.zh: 作耶稣基督仆人和使徒的西门·彼得写信给那因我们的　神和救主耶稣基督之义、与我们同得一样宝贵信心的人。
1.en: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安，因你们认识　神和我们主耶稣，多多地加给你们。
1.en: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

1.zh: 神的神能已将一切关乎生命和虔敬的事赐给我们，皆因我们认识那用自己荣耀和美德召我们的主。
1.en: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

1.zh: 因此，他已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫我们既脱离世上从情欲来的败坏，就得与　神的性情有分。
1.en: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

1.zh: 正因这缘故，你们要分外地殷勤；有了信心，又要加上德行；有了德行，又要加上知识；
1.en: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

1.zh: 有了知识，又要加上节制；有了节制，又要加上忍耐；有了忍耐，又要加上虔敬；
1.en: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

1.zh: 有了虔敬，又要加上爱弟兄的心；有了爱弟兄的心，又要加上爱[众人的心]。
1.en: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

1.zh: 你们若充充足足地有这几样，就必使你们在认识我们的主耶稣基督上不至于闲懒不结果子了。
1.en: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 人若没有这几样，就是眼瞎，只看见近处的，忘了他旧日的罪已经得了洁净。
1.en: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

1.zh: 所以弟兄们，应当更加殷勤，使你们所蒙的恩召和拣选坚定不移。你们若行这几样，就永不失脚；
1.en: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

1.zh: 这样，必叫你们丰丰富富地得以进入我们主—救主耶稣基督永远的国。
1.en: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 你们虽然晓得这些事，并且在你们已有的真道上坚固，我却要将这些事常常提醒你们。
1.en: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

1.zh: 我以为应当趁我还在这帐棚的时候提醒你们，激发你们；
1.en: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

1.zh: 因为知道我脱离这帐棚的时候快到了，正如我们主耶稣基督所指示我的。
1.en: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

1.zh: 并且，我要尽心竭力，使你们在我去世以后时常记念这些事。
1.en: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

1.zh: 我们从前将我们主耶稣基督的大能和他降临的事告诉你们，并不是随从乖巧捏造的虚言，乃是亲眼见过他的威荣。
1.en: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

1.zh: 他从父　神得尊贵荣耀的时候，从极大荣光之中有声音出来，向他说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。」
1.en: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

1.zh: 我们同他在圣山的时候，亲自听见这声音从天上出来。
1.en: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

1.zh: 我们并有先知更确的预言，如同灯照在暗处。你们在这预言上留意，直等到天发亮，晨星在你们心里出现的时候，才是好的。
1.en: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

1.zh: 第一要紧的，该知道经上所有的预言没有可随私意解说的；
1.en: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

1.zh: 因为预言从来没有出于人意的，乃是人被圣灵感动，说出　神的话来。
1.en: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

2.zh: 从前在百姓中有假先知起来，将来在你们中间也必有假师傅，私自引进陷害人的异端，连买他们的主他们也不承认，自取速速地灭亡。
2.en: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

2.zh: 将有许多人随从他们邪淫的行为，便叫真道因他们的缘故被毁谤。
2.en: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

2.zh: 他们因有贪心，要用捏造的言语在你们身上取利。他们的刑罚，自古以来并不迟延；他们的灭亡也必速速来到。
2.en: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

2.zh: 就是天使犯了罪，　神也没有宽容，曾把他们丢在地狱，交在黑暗坑中，等候审判。
2.en: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

2.zh: 神也没有宽容上古的世代，曾叫洪水临到那不敬虔的世代，却保护了传义道的挪亚一家八口。
2.en: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

2.zh: 又判定所多玛、蛾摩拉，将二城倾覆，焚烧成灰，作为后世不敬虔人的鉴戒；
2.en: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

2.zh: 只搭救了那常为恶人淫行忧伤的义人罗得。（
2.en: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

2.zh: 因为那义人住在他们中间，看见听见他们不法的事，他的义心就天天伤痛。）
2.en: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

2.zh: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脱离试探，把不义的人留在刑罚之下，等候审判的日子。
2.en: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

2.zh: 那些随肉身、纵污秽的情欲、轻慢主治之人的，更是如此。 他们胆大任性，毁谤在尊位的，也不知惧怕。
2.en: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

2.zh: 就是天使，虽然力量权能更大，还不用毁谤的话在主面前告他们。
2.en: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

2.zh: 但这些人好像没有灵性，生来就是畜类，以备捉拿宰杀的。他们毁谤所不晓得的事，正在败坏人的时候，自己必遭遇败坏。
2.en: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

2.zh: 行的不义，就得了不义的工价。这些人喜爱白昼宴乐，他们已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正与你们一同坐席，就以自己的诡诈为快乐。
2.en: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

2.zh: 他们满眼是淫色，止不住犯罪，引诱那心不坚固的人，心中习惯了贪婪，正是被咒诅的种类。
2.en: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

2.zh: 他们离弃正路，就走差了，随从比珥之子巴兰的路。巴兰就是那贪爱不义之工价的[先知]，
2.en: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

2.zh: 他却为自己的过犯受了责备；那不能说话的驴以人言拦阻先知的狂妄。
2.en: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

2.zh: 这些人是无水的井，是狂风催逼的雾气，有墨黑的幽暗为他们存留。
2.en: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

2.zh: 他们说虚妄矜夸的大话，用肉身的情欲和邪淫的事引诱那些刚才脱离妄行的人。
2.en: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

2.zh: 他们应许人得以自由，自己却作败坏的奴仆，因为人被谁制伏就是谁的奴仆。
2.en: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

2.zh: 倘若他们因认识主—救主耶稣基督，得以脱离世上的污秽，后来又在其中被缠住、制伏，他们末后的景况就比先前更不好了。
2.en: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

2.zh: 他们晓得义路，竟背弃了传给他们的圣命，倒不如不晓得为妙。
2.en: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

2.zh: 俗语说得真不错： 狗所吐的，它转过来又吃； 猪洗净了又回到泥里去滚； 这话在他们身上正合式。
2.en: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

3.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，我现在写给你们的是第二封信。这两封都是提醒你们，激发你们诚实的心，
3.en: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

3.zh: 叫你们记念圣先知预先所说的话和主救主的命令，就是使徒所传给你们的。
3.en: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

3.zh: 第一要紧的，该知道在末世必有好讥诮的人随从自己的私欲出来讥诮说：
3.en: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

3.zh: 「主要降临的应许在哪里呢？因为从列祖睡了以来，万物与起初创造的时候仍是一样。」
3.en: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

3.zh: 他们故意忘记，从太古，凭　神的命有了天，并从水而出、借水而成的地。
3.en: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

3.zh: 故此，当时的世界被水淹没就消灭了。
3.en: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

3.zh: 但现在的天地还是凭着那命存留，直留到不敬虔之人受审判遭沉沦的日子，用火焚烧。
3.en: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

3.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，有一件事你们不可忘记，就是主看一日如千年，千年如一日。
3.en: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

3.zh: 主所应许的[尚未成就]，有人以为他是耽延，其实不是耽延，乃是宽容你们，不愿有一人沉沦，乃愿人人都悔改。
3.en: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

3.zh: 但主的日子要像贼来到一样。那日，天必大有响声废去，有形质的都要被烈火销化，地和其上的物都要烧尽了。
3.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

3.zh: 这一切既然都要如此销化，你们为人该当怎样圣洁，怎样敬虔，
3.en: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

3.zh: 切切仰望　神的日子来到。在那日，天被火烧就销化了，有形质的都要被烈火熔化。
3.en: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

3.zh: 但我们照他的应许，盼望新天新地，有义居在其中。
3.en: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

3.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，你们既盼望这些事，就当殷勤，使自己没有玷污，无可指摘，安然见主；
3.en: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

3.zh: 并且要以我主长久忍耐为得救的因由，就如我们所亲爱的兄弟保罗，照着所赐给他的智慧写了信给你们。
3.en: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

3.zh: 他一切的信上也都是讲论这事。信中有些难明白的，那无学问、不坚固的人强解，如强解别的经书一样，就自取沉沦。
3.en: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

3.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，你们既然预先知道这事，就当防备，恐怕被恶人的错谬诱惑，就从自己坚固的地步上坠落。
3.en: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

3.zh: 你们却要在我们主—救主耶稣基督的恩典和知识上有长进。愿荣耀归给他，从今直到永远。阿们！
3.en: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
